Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO timing & early-pay option

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the warm welcome — excited to get Arrival Works set up with Redwood. Two quick items on the onboarding side that will determine how we route this internally:

1) Payment terms: Our standard is Net 60, but Finance is open to a short pilot on earlier payment for the first 2 invoices while our systems sync. Would Redwood consider Net 30 for the first two invoices and revert to Net 60 after that?

2) Early-pay option: If earlier settlement is available, what are the fees or discounts you offer for accelerated payment?

Attached: Arrival_Works_W9.pdf and AW_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (the onboarding form includes our billing contacts and sample invoices). I can also loop in our AP team if helpful.

Looking forward to next steps — we have a PO number pending, but wanted to flag timing constraints so our procurement team can map the flow.

Best,
Elena Ortiz

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for sending the form. Welcome aboard. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Redwood standard terms for new suppliers default to Net 30 unless a different cadence is set during procurement. We can discuss a short Net 30 pilot for the first two invoices as you requested, then transition back to Net 60.

- Early-pay: we do offer accelerated settlement options through our AP program. Typical commercial approach is a small percentage fee on the invoice for earlier remittance; Marissa (cc'd) can outline the fee bands and how we operationalize the program.

Action items from my side:
- Please complete the attached AW_Onboarding_Form.xlsx and return it with your company tax ID and remittance address.
- I enclose our Redwood_PO_Template.docx so your procurement team has the PO fields we expect (PO number, invoice routing email, remit-to address, payment terms field).

I'll let Marissa and David pick up on the specifics (fee schedule, accounting receiving method). If you prefer, we can set a 20-minute call tomorrow to finalize the pilot parameters.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO timing & early-pay option

Hi Elena — copying Accounting to keep everyone aligned. A few practical notes from procurement/accounting: 

1) Invoice routing: we require the PO number in the invoice header and submission to invoices@redwood.com. If you plan to send invoices via SFTP or through our AP portal, let us know and we can provide onboarding credentials.

2) Early-pay options (standard options we offer):
- 15-day settlement: 1.75% discount on invoice amount
- 30-day settlement (pilot): 1.00% discount on invoice amount
- 45-day settlement: 0.50% discount on invoice amount

We can pilot Net 30 for the first two invoices with the 1.00% early-pay fee applied if you elect to be paid within 30 days. After the pilot the account would revert to the Net 60 terms you mentioned unless we agree otherwise.

3) PO fields: please ensure your AP team populates the Redwood cost center and project tags on the PO (fields called: RW-CostCenter / RW-Project). These are required for our GL mapping. The Redwood_PO_Template.docx I attached to Rishi has the exact field names.

4) Timeline: if you return the completed onboarding form and W-9 by EOD Monday (9/6) we can aim to have the PO created in time for your first invoice in mid-September.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through the template together.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Hi Marissa / Rishi — thanks, that all sounds doable.

We confirmed internally and would like to proceed with the Net 30 pilot for the first two invoices using the 1.00% early-pay fee for 30-day settlement. We'll submit the completed AW_Onboarding_Form.xlsx and the signed W-9 by EOD tomorrow.

Please confirm the PO number format you prefer so our procurement system can reference it correctly (we tend to require a 12-digit PO id on our side). Also confirm we should send invoices to invoices@redwood.com and that the PO number must be in the invoice subject line.

Once we have your confirmation I'll ask AP to submit the first invoice as soon as the PO is generated.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this turned on.

Best,
Elena
